on_screen_text.text: OLANDRIA SPEAKS ON THE IMPORTANCE OF VOTING
What would you say to the people in our generation who feel like voting does not matter?
I would have to say your vote matters.
I don't know where y'all get that from, but your vote matter.
Make your voices heard. Come on, let's collaborate. Let's, let's get together and amplify our voices 'cause they don't like when we do that.
So get out there and vote.

Olandria responds emphatically that their vote does matter and urges them to make their voices heard. She says, "Let's get together and amplify our voices 'cause they don't like when we do that. So get out there and vote."
